method: Hand-authored from the supplier documents. Labels tagged 'pre-registered' correspond to outcomes recorded in DATA_MANIFEST.md section 2 during corpus construction, before any AI system existed; those are free of anchoring by construction. Labels tagged 'post-hoc' required fresh judgement after the system had run, and carry a disclosed risk that the author was anchored by having seen its output. Accuracy is reported separately for the two subsets.
limitations: One annotator, who also authored the corpus and the system. A sound evaluation would use independent annotators and report inter-annotator agreement, which establishes the ceiling on achievable performance.
Where competent reviewers could reasonably disagree, the label carries alsoAcceptable alternatives rather than forcing a single answer.
